methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: This paper presents the development of a conceptual map regarding energy management applied to industry.

stage1.ineligibility_reason: The paper develops a conceptual map/framework for the organisational structure and stakeholder relationships of an EnMS under ISO 50001. EnPI/EnB are referenced only incidentally within the generic energy-review description; no EnPI/EnB measurement model is identified or characterised (no variables, functional form, or construction/estimation approach), so it fails the v2.3 eligibility threshold and matches the framework-without-EnPI/EnB-model-content exclusion.

paper_type.evidence_quote: ISO 50001-based conceptual map for energy management in energy-intensive industries

stage1.notes: Names EII sectors (cement, iron and steel, pulp and paper, petrochemical, glass) only as generic examples; no EnPI/EnB model characterised. Conceptual-map/framework; EnPI mentioned incidentally.
